title: spec + ui text still names the `feature_flags` settings namespace PR #30272 removes (kernel docblocks, the Settings hub subtitle)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

Filing gate ①: shipped text that will say something wrong once PR #30272 (#30204) merges. Found by that PR's contract review (6649883787, should-fix 2 and 3); both sit outside its file surface (`packages/spec/**`, `ui/**`). No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes it (spec half and ui half may split).

## Defect

PR #30272 removes the `feature_flags` settings namespace (its four keys had no reader), its Setup entry and the `featureFlagsSettingsManifest` export. Two shipped texts still point readers at it:

1. `packages/spec/src/kernel/index.ts:20`–`22` and `packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts:21`–`23`: live toggles "live on the `feature_flags` settings manifest (ADR-0007, `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*`)". After the merge there is no such manifest and the env vars do nothing.
2. `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts:2252` and `de.ts:1825` (and every locale carrying `console.settingsHub.subtitle`): "Configure your system, integrations, and feature flags." This renders on the Settings hub header (`SettingsHub.tsx:127`) and promises a page that is gone.

## Business reason

An administrator reads the Settings hub promising feature flags and finds none; a developer reading the spec docblocks sets `OS_FEATURE_FLAGS_*` and nothing changes.

## Acceptance

1. The two spec docblocks name the live answer (a plugin's own settings manifest; `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` for deployment-advertised capabilities) or drop the sentence.
2. `console.settingsHub.subtitle` drops "feature flags" in every locale.
3. Land after PR #30272 merges.

## Dedup

Searched issues: `feature_flags` (hits #30204, #30275 only). #30275 covers the `skills/**` reference; this card covers spec and ui text only.
